<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1364
Claimant:
Benjamin Ferguson
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
November 10, 2023
First notice of loss came in from the insured's representative, who reported a side impact at a signalized intersection
and a back strain to the claimant, who was the driver of the vehicle struck on the passenger side.
November 13, 2023
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss, with nothing
suggesting the damage happened beofre coverage started.
March 9, 2024
Police report and two statements confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact, though no independent
witness has come forward to describe the collision itself and no photographs of the scene have been provided.
April 10, 2024
Reviewed the vehicle file and found no earlier damage recorded on the vehicle, but the repair estimate covers more
panels than the impact area clearly shows, so it is not yet clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
May 3, 2024
Claimant's representative provided medical records showing a back strain treated with physiotherapy and medication;
the reported injury is plausible for a crash of this type, and no earlier injury to the same body area appears in the
records we hold.
May 4, 2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, so I have asked the treating provider for a note
explaining the continued care before setting any reserve.
May 6, 2024
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in every conversation so far, including the initial call, the
recorded statement and the follow-up with the representative, and the details have not shifted.
June 8, 2024
Nothing independent confirms how the collision happened, so the file remains open pending the provider note and a
review of the damage estimate against the impact pattern.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
